quote.text: So convenient a thing it is to be a reasonable creature, since it enables one to find or make a reason for every thing one has a mind to do.
quote.author: Benjamin Franklin, The Autobiography (Part One) — written of the afternoon he gave up vegetarianism because the cod smelled good

stories.kicker: The Atelier · polish, brushes and trees
stories.headline: A good stockist’s shelf shows three independent French, Spanish and British names. One company in the Charente owns all three, and also makes the lasts
stories.dek: And the grail tier here is the clearest case this desk has found of paying more for less function: a hundred-and-twelve-euro tree that cannot do the job a thirty-three-euro one does.

stories.kicker: Technology · the man who wrote the reports
stories.headline: David Robinson led the writing of OpenAI’s safety reports. He resigned on Friday saying the problem is not the rules but the culture — and that the care the reports describe is not being achieved
stories.dek: The reports he wrote were the only external evidence anyone had. His resignation is a statement that the instrument was never independent of the thing it measured.

stories.kicker: Fitness · the measure that won the crown
stories.headline: Isometric training tops every ranking for lowering blood pressure. A new trial says three sessions a week is the dose — and the same research group says the ranking rests on the wrong measurement
stories.dek: Nine and a half points of systolic in four weeks, from a wall squat. Then the maintenance arm, which is the part nobody has published before.

stories.kicker: The World · four counts, one day
stories.headline: Yemen’s president declared a ground offensive on Sunday. By nightfall four armies had published four tallies of the same twenty-four hours, and the two from the same coalition differ by a factor of nearly three
stories.dek: The Houthis have cut the Taiz–Aden road, which is the one thing nobody contests. Everything counted on top of it comes from a party to the fight.

stories.kicker: Singapore · the plate and the air
stories.headline: A plate of chicken rice gained eighty-nine calories in two years. The agency that measured it says it does not yet know why, and prints the sentence anyway
stories.dek: Sodium is up fifteen per cent since 2019 and sugar is down. Seven in ten residents now eat out at least once a day, which is the number that explains both.

stories.kicker: The Kit · two flagships, one checked claim
stories.headline: Nothing says forty-six decibels of cancellation from ten microphones. Technics says forty-five hours. Only one of those numbers has been put to a stopwatch by somebody outside the company
stories.dek: Both landed in the same week at four hundred-odd dollars. Neither has a Singapore price, and one of them is already sold out at source.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · two anniversaries, two prices
stories.headline: One watch costs sixty-nine thousand francs and the maker’s website would not load. The other costs three thousand eight hundred and ninety-five, and its price is on the maker’s own page
stories.dek: Both arrived last week; both are limited editions. Only one of them can be checked without taking a reviewer’s word for the number.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · the same score, four times the money
stories.headline: Two films opened on Friday with identical Metascores of forty-five. One took thirty-two point six million over the weekend and the other took eight
stories.dek: The aggregate critic number predicted nothing. The audience numbers ran thirty-six and twenty points above the critics, in opposite proportions to the box office.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · ten months, no outcomes
stories.headline: Australia’s under-sixteen social-media ban has been law since December. The study designed to say whether it worked published its method last week — and not a single result
stories.dek: Four thousand one hundred and twenty-one young people are being followed across five waves. Until they report, the only number in circulation counts deleted accounts.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · a number you can derive
stories.headline: Payrolls came in at twenty-nine thousand against ninety thousand expected. Stocks rallied, the dollar eased — and the ten-year yield went up anyway, because five of the last seven basis points were real
stories.dek: Nobody publishes the term premium. But the real yield is nominal minus breakeven, and both halves are published daily by the same agency.

stories.headline: Stained glass
stories.dek: Two crafts share one name, and the argument between them is a quarter of an inch of metal. One is a thousand years old and holds cathedrals up; the other was invented to make lampshades, and is the one a hundred and seventy-eight thousand people have taken up on the internet.

stories.headline: Every row below was re-checked at a venue or an official seller this morning. Three things we have carried are no longer bookable, and the sumo tournament worth flying for does not go on sale until December
stories.dek: The ticket pages themselves refused us, so what follows is sale dates and prices from the operators — not live inventory. Where we cannot see the shelf, we say so.

stories.headline: Kalan de uling
stories.dek: A gas cylinder costs three days of the minimum wage, paid at once. A day’s charcoal costs twenty pesos, paid today. When the first number doubled, Filipino households did not economise on cooking — they moved down a rung, and the rung they landed on is priced by the bag.
